title: The Cellar of the Ninth Floor
author: Emrys Sandoval
blurb: Isandro Yarrow, a folklorist recording songs the village refuses to sing twice, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must finish the ritual the founders started before the harvest moon rises.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
